extDescription: Sign in with logins and codes from Nodkey on your iPhone. You approve every request with Face ID.
pairIntro: Nodkey keeps your logins and codes on your iPhone. Pair this browser once. Then you approve each request on your phone.
pairCodeHelp: In Nodkey on your iPhone, open Agents, tap Add agent and type this code:
pairCodeValid: The code is valid for $1 minutes.
pairCheckHelp: Your iPhone shows a check number. Is it the same as this one? Confirm it on your iPhone too.
pairDifferentDone: The pairing was not saved. Cancel it on your iPhone too, then pair again.
pairExpired: The code expired. Get a new code.
pairOldApp: Update Nodkey on your iPhone, then pair again. This extension needs a newer version of the app to pair.
pairCheckFailed: The pairing did not finish, so nothing was saved. Cancel it on your iPhone and try again, for example on another network.
pairConfirmLate: The number was confirmed after 10 minutes, so nothing was saved. Pair again.
siteNone: Open a website to sign in with Nodkey.
siteInsecure: This page does not use HTTPS. Nodkey does not fill passwords here.
actWaitingHint: The request waits up to two minutes.
actNoField: Nodkey found no field to fill on this page.
fillOtherSite: Not filled: Nodkey saved this account for $1, not for $2.
fillNoSite: Not filled: this account has no website in Nodkey that matches $1.
actNoPassword: Your iPhone sent no password for $1.
actDenied: You denied the request on your iPhone.
actExpired: Your iPhone did not answer in time.
actPaused: Nodkey on your iPhone paused this browser. Resume it under Agents in Nodkey.
actOldProtocol: Update Nodkey on your iPhone and this extension. They use different versions.
actNotSigned: Nodkey could not confirm that this answer came from your iPhone, so it used nothing. Try again.
actNotPaired: Your iPhone does not know this browser any more. Pair again.
actRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
actUnreachable: Nodkey cannot reach the relay. Check your connection and try again.
actPasskeySignedIn: Signed in to $1 with a passkey.
actPasskeyCreated: Saved a new passkey for $1 in Nodkey.
actPasskeyExists: Nodkey on your iPhone has a passkey for this account on $1 already.
actPasskeyNone: Nodkey on your iPhone has no passkey for $1.
actPasskeyCancelled: The page stopped the passkey request.
actNeedsPairing: Pair Nodkey with your iPhone first: click the Nodkey button in the toolbar.
saveAsk: Save the login for $1 in Nodkey?
saveAdded: Saved in Nodkey on your iPhone.
saveUpdated: The password is updated in Nodkey on your iPhone.
saveUnchanged: Nodkey on your iPhone has this login already.
saveDenied: Not saved. You said no on your iPhone.
saveKept: Your iPhone did not answer. The login waits, locked so that only your iPhone can read it. Send it again from the Nodkey button.
reasonPasskeyGet: Sign in to $1 with a passkey in $2
optNameHelp: The new name shows on your iPhone the next time you pair.
optNoPhone: Not paired yet. Click the Nodkey button in the toolbar to pair.
optUnpairHelp: This browser leaves your iPhone. Nodkey on the iPhone removes it the next time it checks for requests.
optScreenshots: Show a picture of the page in the notification
optScreenshotsHelp: The picture is encrypted so that only your iPhone can see it.
optPasskeysHelp: When a website asks for a passkey, Nodkey asks your iPhone. Turn this off to use the passkeys of the browser. Open pages change when you load them again.
optSiteAccessHelp: Nodkey needs access to websites to show its button in sign-in fields and to fill them.
optSiteAccessSafari: In Safari, click Nodkey in the toolbar and choose “Always Allow on Every Website”. Or open Safari Settings, Extensions, Nodkey, Edit Websites.
optSiteAccessOk: Nodkey can work on all websites.
optRelayHelp: The relay forwards encrypted messages between this browser and your iPhone. Change it only if you run your own relay.
optRelayHttps: Type an address that starts with https://. Plain http:// works only for a relay on this computer.
cardTotalRead: The total is read from the page: $1
cardTotalMissing: Nodkey found no total on this page. Type the amount you will pay.
cardNotStored: The card is filled in here and is not stored in the browser.
cardAmountInvalid: Type the amount as a number, for example 499,00.
cardWaiting: Approve the payment of $1 on your iPhone
cardFilled: $1 filled in for at most $2. Check the order, then pay.
cardTotalHigher: The total on the page is higher than the amount you approved. Nodkey did not fill in the card.
cardTotalRose: The total changed to $1 after Nodkey filled in the card. Nodkey removed the card from the fields.
cardNoField: Nodkey found no card fields to fill on this page.
cardOtherSite: The card fields belong to another website. Nodkey fills cards only on the shop's own website.
cardInsecure: This page does not use HTTPS. Nodkey does not fill cards here.
cardOff: Cards are off for this browser. Turn them on under Agents in Nodkey on your iPhone.
cardOverLimit: The amount is above your limit for this browser. Your iPhone said no without asking you.
cardNone: No card in Nodkey may be used by this browser. Choose the cards under Agents in Nodkey.
cardBadRequest: Nodkey could not send this payment request.
reasonSaveCard: Save the card you just used on $1 in $2
cardSaved: The card is saved in Nodkey on your iPhone.
cardSaveUpdated: The card in Nodkey on your iPhone is updated.
cardSaveDenied: The card was not saved. You said no on your iPhone.
actPausedLimit: Nodkey on your iPhone paused this browser because it got many new logins and codes today. Resume it under Agents in Nodkey.
actQuotaWarning: This browser got $1 new logins and codes today, so your iPhone asks with a notice. Approve each request in the Nodkey app.
methodFederated: You sign in to $1 with $2. Click the $2 button on the page. Nodkey fills your $2 login only on the sign-in page of $2.
methodFederatedOnly: You sign in to $1 with $2. Click the $2 button on the page.
methodPasskey: You sign in to $1 with a passkey. Use the passkey button on the page.
methodEmailCode: $1 sends you a sign-in code by e-mail.
methodSso: You sign in to $1 with the single sign-on of your company.
methodSms: $1 sends you a sign-in code by SMS.
viaHint: Nodkey has your $1 login $2 for $3. Click the Nodkey button in the field to fill it.
learnDetail: Your iPhone gets only the site and the name of the provider, encrypted. You accept it in the Nodkey app.
learnWaiting: Sending the suggestion to your iPhone
learnQueued: Your iPhone has the suggestion. Accept it in the Nodkey app.
learnRejected: Your iPhone did not take the suggestion now. You can try again later.
stepButton: Use a passkey or a code from Nodkey
stepWorking: Nodkey chooses another way to sign in.
stepNone: This page offers no passkey or code from Nodkey. Choose a way to sign in on the page.
smsButton: Get the SMS code with Nodkey
smsWaiting: Waiting for the SMS. When it arrives, approve on your iPhone.
smsExpired: No SMS code reached Nodkey in time. On your iPhone, check the Shortcuts automation that sends codes to Nodkey.
